mechanics.name: Dark Sense
mechanics.currentEffect: Whenever a Generator is completed, Dark Sense activates. When the Killer comes within 20 metres of you, for 13/14/15 seconds you see the Killer's Aura, the Auras of other Survivors, and the Auras of Pallets and Windows within 32 metres. The perk then deactivates until another Generator is completed.
activation: While the perk is active, the Killer comes within 20 metres.
Ends/deactivates when: The Aura-reading window ends after 13/14/15 seconds and Dark Sense deactivates until another Generator is completed.
mechanics.patchNote: Latest live balance change (10.2.0): Reworked to trigger at 20 metres and reveal the Killer, other Survivors, and nearby Pallets/Windows for 13/14/15 seconds after a Generator completion arms the perk.
mechanics.plainEnglishSummary: Generator completion arms a multi-Aura information window that triggers when the Killer approaches within 20 metres.
mechanics.oncePerTrialOrOtherLimits: Reactivates on each subsequent Generator completion.
specialInteractions: During the active window, reveals the Killer and other Survivors, plus Pallets and Windows within 32 metres.

editorial.summary: Each Generator completion arms a 13–15 second information burst that reveals the Killer, teammates, Pallets, and Windows when the Killer comes within 20 metres.
useCases: Receive an early warning when the Killer approaches after a generator completion.
Use the long Aura read to understand their direction through walls.
Bank the trigger until the Killer actually enters a relevant local range.
counters: Requires a generator to complete before each use.
Only triggers when the Killer comes within 20 metres.
Undetectable and Aura denial can suppress the key information.
pros: Trigger waits for the Killer to approach rather than firing immediately at generator completion.
cons: No benefit before the team makes objective progress.
analysis: Dark Sense is effectively a new perk in 10.2. When armed by a Generator completion and triggered by the Killer approaching within 20 metres, it reveals the Killer, all other Survivors, and nearby Pallets and Windows for up to fifteen seconds.

That is a huge amount of information in one window. Newer players receive the map-learning utility that old Windows of Opportunity used to provide, while experienced players can use the Killer Aura and teammate positions to make precise chase and rotation decisions.
The activation is not permanent. A Generator must complete first, and the information waits until the Killer enters local range, so a quiet portion of the match can still pass without value.
The 10.1 ranking is no longer meaningful. Dark Sense moved from a narrow Killer-warning perk into a broad, free general information package and should be reviewed much higher.
editorial.verdict: One of 10.2’s biggest Survivor information winners. Dark Sense now teaches resources, shows teammates, and tracks the Killer in the same long trigger window.
